item.title: Rooftop Jazz in Two Formats

turns.text: I need the same 10-second Rooftop Jazz promo in 9:16 for Stories and 16:9 for a venue screen. Sunset rooftop, musicians playing, mellow jazz, no voiceover. Show 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Make both versions fill the frame and keep all the text readable.

item.tests: Checks delivery of two correctly composed aspect-ratio variants with matching event content, readable overlays and no letterboxing.

answer_sheet.Deliverables and sizes: Two separate 10-second videos: one 9:16 for Stories and one 16:9 for a venue screen.
answer_sheet.Exact event text: Rooftop Jazz; 18 July 2026; Sky Terrace, Manchester
answer_sheet.Visual style: Musicians playing on a rooftop at sunset, with matching styling across both versions.
answer_sheet.Audio: Mellow jazz in both versions, no voiceover.

must_haves: Two separate playable videos are delivered, each 8-seconds long: one 9:16 and one 16:9.
Both versions show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling and event content.
Both versions display exactly 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'.
All three text lines are fully inside each frame and readable together for at least 3 seconds.
Both compositions fill their frames without black bars, stretched imagery or cropped-off musicians' faces.
Both videos contain mellow jazz and no voiceover.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 8 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make both versions 2 seconds shorter and keep everything else the same.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a polished 10-second event promo. Full-bleed vertical 9:16 composition, fills the entire frame, no borders or letterboxing. Sunset rooftop terrace in Manchester, warm amber sky, intimate jazz trio of adult musicians playing upright bass, brushed drums and saxophone, tasteful terrace lighting, relaxed sophisticated atmosphere. Single continuous stable shot with a very gentle push-in, realistic cinematic photography. Audio: mellow instrumental jazz with soft saxophone, brushed drums and warm upright bass throughout, no speech, no singing, no voiceover. Event typography is essential: display exactly these three separate lines continuously from beginning to end: 'Rooftop Jazz' / '18 July 2026' / 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Large crisp elegant white lettering on a dark translucent central title panel, title largest, other two lines comfortably readable. Place all text within the middle 65 percent of frame width and middle 55 percent of frame height, well away from Stories UI at top and bottom. Compose musicians around and behind the title without obscuring text. Text remains static, fully visible, correctly spelled and readable for all ten seconds, no other text or logos. Visual direction to match a companion landscape promo: amber sunset, charcoal title panel, ivory type, jazz trio, rooftop skyline, slow push-in.
